style.assigned_requirement: Expressive adult narrative illustration with broad color planes/dry brush-dark contour, central chair action and foreground shared clothing repair, flanking readable copy
style.observed: Coral/teal adult figures, warm wooden chair, blue garment and near cloth cropped across lower edge with layered brush strokes. Faces and surfaces are more modeled than the guide's placeholders. Central arms and chair/fabric silhouette organize open text space.
style.basic_exclusion_observation: Full-scale content-grounded body/tool/garment action organizes the poster. No tiny illustration attachment, passive split-field heading template or empty-room lettering.

ratio.policy: Nearest-integer native rounding of one edge <=0.5px permitted; original not resized.

substantive_visual.observations: Two different adults now co-grip one screwdriver at one chair, while foreground hands jointly support and stitch a patched garment.

hangul.observations: Consistent mature sans-serif bodies and counters with meaningful word spaces; paragraph has stable left alignment and four continuous lines. Title has a heavier weight than planned Light treatment.

information_relationship.observations: Invitation/body/event left, English above joint action, title/meaning/schedule right, thread/fabric returning to deadline and URL left lower. Title is stronger first anchor than invitation in thumbnail.

function_contact.observations: Man's teal sleeve-to-forearm-to-grip is continuous; woman's hand touches same driver top. Screw head sits directly under shaft. Foreground needle is placed at patch edge and hands share blue fabric.

material_edges.observations: Painterly wood/cloth/skin planes retain local strokes and overlap; printed letters remain sharp and untextured. Foreground stitching is dense but recognizable at usage720.

residuals.limit: Original tear is largely covered; patch and stitch action convey mending more explicitly than the rip.
